description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableDittoHeaders class, which is part of a Java project related to handling headers in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package. The tests verify immutability, equality, header creation, JSON serialization, and various header manipulations within the context of the project.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoHeadersTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests to verify the immutability, equality, header creation, and JSON serialization of ImmutableDittoHeaders.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableDittoHeaders is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the hashCode and equals method implementations for ImmutableDittoHeaders.

methods.name: settingAllKnownHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that setting all known headers results in the expected header map.

methods.name: createInstanceOfValidHeaderMapWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests creation of ImmutableDittoHeaders from a pre-defined header map.

methods.name: createInstanceOfValidHeaderJsonObjectWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests creation from a JsonObject.

methods.name: createInstanceContainingArbitraryKeyValuePair
methods.description: Tests that arbitrary key-value pairs can be added.

methods.name: getCorrelationIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of correlation ID.

methods.name: getSchemaVersionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of schema version.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of authorization context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks retrieval of authorization subjects.

methods.name: getReadSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of read subjects.

methods.name: getReadGrantedSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of read granted subjects.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of revoked subjects.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredIsTrueByDefault
methods.description: Checks default response required value.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredReturnsFalseLikeSet
methods.description: Checks response required when explicitly set to false.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredReturnsTrueLikeSet
methods.description: Checks response required when explicitly set to true.

methods.name: isResponseRequiredStaysFalseEvenIfRequiredAckLabelsAreSet
methods.description: Ensures responseRequired is false even if acknowledgment labels are set.

methods.name: isDryRunIsFalseByDefault
methods.description: Checks default dryRun value.

methods.name: isDryRunReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks dryRun when explicitly set.

methods.name: getRequestedAckLabelsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies acknowledgment requests retrieval.

methods.name: timeoutIsSerializedAsString
methods.description: Verifies timeout serialization to JSON.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPutReturnsEmptySet
methods.description: Checks that headers to put are empty in the test case.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPutReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests retrieval of metadata headers to put.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the JSON serialization of headers for correctness.

methods.name: removesDuplicatedAuthSubjectsFromHeaderMap
methods.description: Checks that duplicate authorization subjects are removed.

methods.name: removesDuplicatedAuthSubjectsFromJsonRepresentation
methods.description: Checks that JSON representation removes duplicate subjects.

methods.name: putThrowsUnsupportedOperationException
methods.description: Verifies that put operation is unsupported (immutability).

methods.name: putAllThrowsUnsupportedOperationException
methods.description: Verifies that putAll operation is unsupported.

methods.name: removeThrowsUnsupportedOperationException
methods.description: Verifies that remove operation is unsupported.

methods.name: clearThrowsUnsupportedOperationException
methods.description: Verifies that clear operation is unsupported.

methods.name: entrySetIsUnmodifiable
methods.description: Checks that the entrySet is unmodifiable.

methods.name: allKnownHeadersAreTested
methods.description: Ensures the test covers all known header keys.

methods.name: tryToCheckIfEntriesSizeIsGreaterThanNegativeLong
methods.description: Tests validation for negative size comparison.

methods.name: entriesSizeIsGreaterThanZeroIfHeadersAreNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks size comparison when headers are present.

methods.name: entriesSizeIsNotGreaterThanZeroIfHeadersAreEmpty
methods.description: Checks size comparison when headers are empty.

methods.name: entriesSizeIsNotGreaterThanComparedSize
methods.description: Checks that size comparison returns false when size is less.

methods.name: entriesSizeIsGreaterThanComparedSize
methods.description: Checks that size comparison returns true when size is greater.

methods.name: truncateLargeHeaders
methods.description: Tests truncation of headers exceeding specified size.
